dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Ah, such a rich aroma truly makes you feel refreshed and alive.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I've tasted dishes from both Liuli Pavilion and Xinyue Kiosk, but you can't fully appreciate a country's cuisines if you only stick to high-end restaurants.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I leave it to you to bring me around and taste the local snacks and specialties, alright?
